name: monstera-release-verification
description: Run every gate, wait for CI on the release head, collect evidence unchanged, and have a read-only auditor check every claim in the release report.

steps.prompt: Run `monstera gates` and save the output to .kiro/workflow-output/release/gates.txt. Record the HEAD commit. Stop and report if any gate fails. Run the gates once.

CI result: {{ci.output}}. If the CI watch timed out, record the runs as pending in the report and do not poll again; claim nothing for them. Otherwise download the artifacts of those runs with gh and copy the relevant ones unchanged to docs/evidence/{{release}}/, each folder with a SOURCE.txt (run id, job, commit, runner, what was copied). Never copy .app bundles or SDK material. Update {{report}} with the run ids and results; write no result you did not observe.

Audit {{report}} against docs/evidence/{{release}}/ and the verification labels in .kiro/steering/04-generation-and-provenance.md. For every claim, cite the evidence file or mark it UNSUPPORTED. Flag any label higher than its evidence. End with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
